title: Understanding Random Forests
text: Random forests are ensemble methods that use multiple decision trees to make predictions. They can capture complex patterns in data.

title: Decision Boundaries in Random Forests
text: Random forests can create non-linear decision boundaries by combining the outputs of multiple decision trees.
